profile.headline: Experienced Principal-Level Full Stack Web Developer
profile.summary:
• Highly-skilled and seasoned full-stack web application developer/designer with over 20 years of experience in all things web related
• Proficient in all areas of the development lifecycle from concept to completion, including planning, designing, developing, and deploying robust web applications and websites of all sizes
• Passionate about web standards and creating exceptional user experiences
• Detail-oriented analytical thinker possessing strong technical and problem-solving skills and an ability to learn new skills quickly
• Well-rounded, multitalented creative thinker with excellent verbal and written communication skills

Experienced in a wide array of architectures, languages, technologies, platforms, hardware, and software, including, but not limited to:

• Programming Languages: PHP, Python, Ruby
• Web Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, LESS, SASS, REST APIs
• UI/UX: Graphic design, image creation, UI design, wireframing, prototyping
• Frameworks: Zend Framework, jQuery, Bootstrap
• Databases: MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server
• Version Control: Git, Subversion
• Platforms & Tools: macOS, iOS, Linux, Salesforce, Visual Studio Code, Postman, Apple Xcode, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Affinity Designer, Affinity Photo, Pixelmator Pro

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained internal clinical web applications using PHP/Laravel, Vue.js, and PostgreSQL to support pathologist and clinical analyst workflows for variant review, QC assessment, and clinical reporting
• Collaborated with pathologists, clinical analysts, bioinformaticians, and other software engineers to translate requirements and deliver web solutions across interconnected applications
• Analyzed, debugged, and tested existing codebases to provide functional updates and feature enhancements to support new assays and evolving workflows

positions.title: Principal Developer
positions.description:
• Principal Developer:  July 2019 – November 2024
• Sr. Developer:  September 2003 – July 2019
• via Robert Half: December 2001 – September 2003

Designed, developed, and delivered web solutions in a LAMP environment using PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL:

• Collaborated with cross-functional teams of designers, developers, analysts, project managers, and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and plan solutions that aligned with project goals and objectives
• Worked independently on small teams as the sole designer/developer, and assisted on large projects as one of several developers
• Interacted with various internal business and functional groups
• Translated requirements to wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to convey design concepts and solicit feedback from stakeholders and team members
• Developed Bootstrap-based CSS system using SASS that incorporated corporate brand guidelines and User Interface Design System standards
• Created image assets, icons, and other design elements needed for applications
• Designed and developed applications with a mobile first approach to ensure functionality in both mobile and desktop browsers
• Authored applications that use web service APIs for data sources, single sign-on authentication, user registration, and consent management
• Leveraged Salesforce REST APIs to query and store data
• Created and maintained PHP-, Python-, and Ruby-based ETL cron scripts to transfer data between internal databases and that used web service APIs to query data from external vendor systems
• Documented applications and systems and conducted code reviews as required by project processes or validation and compliance methodologies
• Tested and debugged applications and provided end-user support
• Supported and advised team members, mentored junior developers, and fostered a culture of continuous learning and improvement
• Performed system administration duties on RHEL servers, including Apache and PHP maintenance and configuration

courses.name: Big Nerd Ranch: Beginning iOS Bootcamp (May 2011)

projects.title: Customs & Specials
projects.description: The Customs & Specials web application allows sales reps to submit surgical instrument customization requests for their surgeons. The application acts as a web front-end that interfaces a Salesforce back-end using REST APIs to query product information and store information for the requests. I designed and developed the database and web portions of the application, and I collaborated with Salesforce administrators and developers for the back-end integration.

projects.title: Mazor Navcode
projects.description: The Mazor Navcode web application permits sales reps to enter information for a scheduled surgery to retrieve an access code for a robotic surgical guidance system. I developed the front-end portions of the web application, implementing the design concept produced by a designer on our UX team.
